findings: Do not transfer the fixed four-equal-size-model or 25-percent-memory-saving rule: critic size, optimizer state, reward implementation and placement change the accounting.

The archival objective uses a sequence likelihood ratio where the original token-level GRPO needs token indices and response-length normalization. Equal group rewards remove the centered reward advantage, not necessarily the KL gradient.

Reasoning self-correction examples and fixed-benchmark results must not become guarantees of stability, exploration, or universal superiority over PPO. The full canonical GRPO owner still needs comparison.
